copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: Claude 会从 channels 分支把 Teams 适配器复制进 src/channels/ 并注册、安装固定版本的适配器依赖、构建并跑注册测试;随后引导你用 Teams CLI 登录、创建机器人、写入 .env 凭据、装进 Teams,并把助手连到指定账号。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加 Microsoft Teams 渠道或机器人集成时触发。若 .env 里已存在 Teams 凭据,创建与提示步骤会被整体跳过。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Microsoft Teams 渠道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 用 Teams CLI 帮我新建一个 Teams 机器人
say.note: 引导登录、创建机器人并写入凭据

say.text: 把 Teams 机器人装进我的租户并连到我的账号
say.note: 给出安装链接，并建立机器人与你的会话

howto.what_en: Claude adds a Microsoft Teams channel to NanoClaw: it copies the Teams adapter into src/channels/, registers it, installs the pinned adapter package, builds and runs the registration test, then guides bot creation via the Teams CLI and stores the credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Microsoft Teams channel or bot integration to NanoClaw. If .env already holds Teams credentials, the create and prompt steps are skipped.

say_en.text: Add a Microsoft Teams channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs the test

say_en.text: Create a Teams bot with the Teams CLI
say_en.note: Guides login, bot creation and credentials

say_en.text: Install the Teams bot in my tenant and wire it to my account
say_en.note: Gives an install link and links the bot to you
